## The SaaS Engineering Scaling Challenge

Every SaaS company faces a moment when engineering growth becomes existential. You need to ship faster, but every new hire temporarily reduces velocity while they onboard.

### Scaling Phases

| Team Size | Phase | Key Challenge |
|---|---|---|
| 1-5 | Founding team | Finding co-founding-level talent |
| 5-15 | First hires | Maintaining quality, establishing culture |
| 15-30 | Team structure | Creating pods/squads, first engineering managers |
| 30-50 | Organization | Multiple teams, architecture decisions, process |
| 50+ | Scale | Hiring at volume, maintaining velocity, cultural dilution |

### Phase-Specific Hiring Advice

#### 5 → 15: Quality Over Speed

Your first 10 hires define engineering culture forever:

- Each hire should be someone who could teach the team something
- Hire generalists who can contribute across the stack
- Assess for cultural DNA (values, work style, communication)
- Accept slower hiring if candidate quality is not exceptional

#### 15 → 30: The Manager Transition

This is where many companies stumble:

- Promote your best IC to manager? Or hire externally?
- Answer: Do both. Promote one who shows leadership aptitude, hire one with management experience.
- Every team of 5-7 needs a dedicated manager
- Engineering managers should spend 50%+ time on people, not code

#### 30 → 50: Architecture and Process

At this scale, technical and organizational architecture must align:

- Define clear team boundaries and ownership
- Establish coding standards and review processes
- Implement on-call rotations with proper documentation
- Create technical career ladders (IC and management tracks)

### The Hiring Machine

At 30+ engineers, you need a systematic hiring process:

- Sourcing : Dedicated sourcer or subscription sourcing partner
- Screening : Automated resume review + 30-min phone screen
- Technical assessment : 2-hour structured interview (system design + coding)
- Team fit : 45-min conversation with future teammates
- Decision : Scorecard review within 24 hours

### Engineering Compensation at Scale

| Level | Startup (Seed-A) | Growth (B-C) | Scale (D+) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Junior | $90K + 0.1% | $110K + options | $130K + RSUs |
| Mid | $120K + 0.05% | $145K + options | $170K + RSUs |
| Senior | $150K + 0.03% | $180K + options | $210K + RSUs |
| Staff | $170K + 0.02% | $210K + options | $260K + RSUs |
| Principal | — | $240K + options | $300K+ + RSUs |

### Common Scaling Mistakes

- Hiring too fast : Quality drops, culture dilutes
- Hiring too slow : Burnout, key person risk
- Not investing in management : ICs need support
- Ignoring onboarding : New hires take months to be productive
- Uniform hiring criteria : Senior and junior roles need different assessments
